[07]Then the snake-men began seizing villagers as sacrifices for the cult.
[07]We had to do something, so we sent in a team willing to risk their lives.

[07]That only bought us a little time, and the snake-men started attacking again.
[07]The only way to save the village is to destroy the cult!
